title: Add double-down strategy to blackjack
body: Implements basic double-down when player has 9, 10, or 11.

files.patch:
@@ -10,6 +10,12 @@ def basic_strategy(hand, dealer_upcard):
     if hand.value <= 11:
         return "hit"
     return "stand"
+
+def should_double_down(hand, dealer_upcard):
+    if hand.value in (9, 10, 11) and len(hand.cards) == 2:
+        return True
+    return False

@@ -1,5 +1,10 @@
 from casino.hand import Hand
+from casino.strategies import should_double_down
 
 def test_hand_value():
     hand = Hand(["A", "K"])
     assert hand.value == 21
+
+def test_double_down():
+    hand = Hand(["5", "6"])
+    assert should_double_down(hand, "6") is True
